description: This file defines the LDAPSyncStatus entity class used in the OrangeHRM system for tracking LDAP synchronization status, including properties for timestamps, user info, and status constants.

classes.name: LDAPSyncStatus
classes.description: Entity class representing the status of LDAP synchronization in OrangeHRM, including properties for timestamps, user reference, and sync status constants.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the LDAPSyncStatus record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the LDAPSyncStatus record.

methods.name: getSyncStartedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when LDAP sync started.

methods.name: setSyncStartedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when LDAP sync started.

methods.name: getSyncFinishedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when LDAP sync finished.

methods.name: setSyncFinishedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when LDAP sync finished.

methods.name: getSyncedBy
methods.description: Returns the User object who performed the sync.

methods.name: setSyncedBy
methods.description: Assigns the User who performed the sync.

methods.name: getSyncStatus
methods.description: Returns the current synchronization status as an integer.
